vehicle.automobility.title: Vehicle settings
vehicle.automobility.driver_required: Sit in the driver's seat to open vehicle settings.
vehicle.automobility.light.help.low: Wide, shorter beam angled down for ordinary driving.
vehicle.automobility.light.help.high: Longer forward beam for dark, empty roads.
vehicle.automobility.light.cycle_help: The cycle key selects position → low → high → AUTO. From Off, it starts at position lights. Change the key in Key bindings.
vehicle.automobility.light.help.auto: Low beams follow world darkness. High beams remain a manual choice.
vehicle.automobility.driving.mode.label: Driving tune for this vehicle
vehicle.automobility.driving.mode.summar: Saved with this vehicle. Change it while stopped.
vehicle.automobility.driving.mode.help: Cycles Default, Touring, Balanced and Sport for this vehicle. Default follows the server or Momentum settings, including a read-only Custom tune. Other Momentum options and cruise control stay unchanged.
vehicle.automobility.driving.mode.config: Changing the tune requires the driver's seat and configuration permission.
vehicle.automobility.driving.mode.stoppe: Stop the vehicle before changing its driving tune.
vehicle.automobility.driving.mode.server: The server disables vehicle tunes. You can restore Default while stopped.
vehicle.automobility.driving.mode.reject: The vehicle has not confirmed the change. The displayed tune remains authoritative.
vehicle.automobility.profiles.preview.dr: The vehicle's driving tune cannot be applied now. Stop the vehicle and check server permission.
vehicle.automobility.driving.global_help: This is the global Momentum setting, shared by all vehicles. Change it in Momentum options.
vehicle.automobility.driving.server_help: The server sets the Momentum tune for every vehicle. This panel only shows the active setting.
vehicle.automobility.cruise.help: Existing Momentum cruise control. Braking, drifting, reversing or an impact disengages it.
vehicle.automobility.display.local_help: Saved on this client. These settings change only the light status panel.
vehicle.automobility.save_failed: Could not save settings. See the game log.
vehicle.automobility.too_small: The window is too small for vehicle settings. Reduce GUI scale or enlarge the window.
key.automobility.toggle_vehicle_high_bea: Cycle position / low / high / AUTO lights
vehicle.automobility.light.help.position: Feux de position blancs à l’avant et feux rouges à l’arrière, sans faisceau de phares.
vehicle.automobility.access.title: Vehicle access
vehicle.automobility.access.open_help: Ownership, shared keys and quiet lock sounds.
vehicle.automobility.access.claim_help: Claiming makes the vehicle private. Dismount and unlock before releasing ownership.
vehicle.automobility.access.general_help: Only key holders can enter a locked vehicle.
vehicle.automobility.access.name_help: Enter an online player's name or their full UUID. Up to 8 shared keys.
vehicle.automobility.access.sharing_help: A key allows driving even when locked. Allow configuration separately in the Lock tab.
vehicle.automobility.access.sounds_help: Choose silence or a quiet click on locking and unlocking. The lock does not flash indicators or sound the horn.
vehicle.automobility.access.denied: You do not have permission for this vehicle.
vehicle.automobility.access.invalid_targ: Cannot add key: check the name, UUID and key limit.
vehicle.automobility.access.profile_appl: Profile applied; settings respect server limits.
vehicle.automobility.profiles.title: Profiles
vehicle.automobility.profiles.subtitle: Settings for other vehicles
vehicle.automobility.profiles.save_help: Save this vehicle's engine, light mode, turn cancellation, three-flash indicators and lock sound. The same name replaces an existing profile.
vehicle.automobility.profiles.apply_help: Applying requires driving and configuration permission. Owner, keys, lock and ignition remain unchanged.
vehicle.automobility.profiles.preview.op: Review the saved settings first. Applying requires a separate confirmation in the preview.
vehicle.automobility.profiles.preview.co: Highlighted settings differ from the vehicle. Current → saved profile. Server limits apply.
vehicle.automobility.profiles.preview.ap: Applies configuration only; it does not start the engine. Ownership, keys, current ignition, cruise control, local HUD and graphics stay unchanged. Server limits apply.
vehicle.automobility.profiles.preview.he: Saved configuration only; it does not start the engine. Server limits apply.
vehicle.automobility.profiles.preview.pe: You can view this preview. To apply it, sit in the driver's seat and obtain configuration permission.
vehicle.automobility.profiles.preview.ch: This profile was changed or deleted. Return to the list and open a new preview.
vehicle.automobility.profiles.invalid_na: Enter a name of 1 to 32 characters.
vehicle.automobility.profiles.save_faile: Could not save profile. Up to 16 profiles are supported.
vehicle.automobility.profiles.load_faile: Saved profiles could not be loaded. The file is preserved; saving is disabled.
vehicle.automobility.profiles.help: Profiles belong to you and can be applied to other vehicles. Ownership and keys are never copied.
vehicle.automobility.hud.release_pedal: Release the pedal, then press it again
vehicle.automobility.engine.start_help: Automatic start uses the accelerator after boarding. Manual mode requires the engine key or this button.
vehicle.automobility.engine.shutdown_hel: The timer starts after the last player leaves. Returning cancels it. Server limits apply.
vehicle.automobility.engine.lights.label: Lights follow engine: %s
vehicle.automobility.engine.lights_help: Stop the engine to turn lights off. Starting again restores the selected light mode.
vehicle.automobility.engine.key_hint: Engine key: %s. Vehicle settings are saved with this car.
vehicle.automobility.signals.title: Indicators and hazard lights
vehicle.automobility.signals.open_help: Indicators and hazard lights work independently of headlights and the engine.
vehicle.automobility.signals.help.off: Switch off both indicators and hazard lights.
vehicle.automobility.signals.help.left: Select the left indicator. Its key toggles it off; the right indicator replaces it. It switches off when the driver leaves.
vehicle.automobility.signals.help.right: Select the right indicator. Its key toggles it off; the left indicator replaces it. It switches off when the driver leaves.
vehicle.automobility.signals.help.hazard: Flash both indicators, including with the engine off. Hazard lights stay on when the driver leaves.
vehicle.automobility.signals.auto_cancel: Switches off a turn indicator after completing a turn. Hazard lights stay on. This setting is saved for this vehicle and in profiles.
Changing this setting requires the driver's seat and configuration permission. The driver can still operate ordinary indicators.
vehicle.automobility.signals.driver_only: Only the driver can operate indicators. Hazard lights can stay on after leaving the car.
vehicle.automobility.signals.three_help: Flashes three complete times, then switches off. A separate action from the ordinary indicator keys.
vehicle.automobility.signals.three_disab: Enable three-flash indicators on the Settings page to use these actions.
vehicle.automobility.signals.three_busy: Three-flash indicators can start when ordinary indicators and hazard lights are off.
vehicle.automobility.signals.comfort_hel: Enables the separate three-flash buttons and bindings. Ordinary left/right keys still toggle continuous indicators. Saved with this vehicle and in profiles.
vehicle.automobility.signals.lock_confir: Locking and unlocking do not flash indicators. This legacy option is no longer used.
vehicle.automobility.signals.settings_he: Turn cancellation and three-flash preferences are saved with this vehicle and in profiles.
vehicle.automobility.signals.settings_wa: Waiting for the vehicle to confirm its settings…
vehicle.automobility.signals.settings_re: The vehicle has not confirmed the change. The displayed values are the server's current settings.
vehicle.automobility.effects.title: Vehicle graphics and sound
vehicle.automobility.effects.local_help: Local rendering quality for all vehicle lights. Does not change vehicle light modes or other players' settings.
vehicle.automobility.effects.quality_hel: Simpler road illumination. Colored spill is disabled; glowing lamps and signals stay visible.
Balanced headlight detail and colored spill. Visible lighting shares a finite rendering budget.
More detailed headlights and colored spill. Uses a larger, still finite rendering budget.
vehicle.automobility.effects.volume_help: Quiet tick/tock follows your car's signal phase while you are driving. 0%% mutes it.
vehicle.automobility.effects.save_failed: Could not save. Current settings remain active.
vehicle.automobility.effects.file_preser: Unsupported or unreadable settings file preserved.
vehicle.automobility.effects.quality_hel: Full projection for your car; cones for up to 2 others. Colored spill off.

options.automobility.title: Automobility
options.automobility.vehicle_help: Sit in the driver's seat to open vehicle controls.
options.automobility.advanced_help: Advanced driving, camera and HUD settings. Gameplay choices remain server controlled.
options.automobility.advanced_park: Leave the driver seat before opening the advanced editor. V provides the in-car controls.
options.automobility.advanced_optional: The advanced editor requires optional YACL. Graphics, vehicle controls and key bindings remain available.
options.automobility.advanced_unavailabl: The optional advanced editor could not be opened.
vehicle.automobility.effects.custom_help: Choose projection counts, colored spill and cosmetic smoke. Full projection keeps the same quality and obstacle checks.
vehicle.automobility.custom.title: Custom graphics
vehicle.automobility.custom.main: Your car always uses full projection.
vehicle.automobility.custom.priority_hel: Up to %s additional cars fully illuminate surfaces, even when you look away. This group includes your main car: %s full slots in total. More cars require more light calculations.
vehicle.automobility.custom.visible_help: Up to %s additional cars outside the priority group use the same full projection while their beam footprint is in view. Lights return immediately when you turn back. More cars require more light calculations.
vehicle.automobility.custom.cones_help: Up to %s additional cars outside both full-projection groups show glowing lamps and visual cones. Cones do not illuminate surrounding surfaces. More cones require more rendering work.
vehicle.automobility.custom.spill_help: Small nearby projections from marker, brake, reverse and indicator lamps. Independent of the full headlight count.
vehicle.automobility.custom.drift_help: About %s%% of normal drift smoke. Fewer particles reduce smoke rendering work. Drifting, braking and tire grip stay the same.
vehicle.automobility.custom.exhaust_help: Normal exhaust smoke is not rendered. Boost flames remain visible; engine power and boost stay the same.
vehicle.automobility.custom.cosmetic: Cosmetic only. Driving and boost stay unchanged.
vehicle.automobility.unattended.title: Unattended lights
vehicle.automobility.unattended.help: Switch lights off after the last passenger leaves. Independent of the engine timer.
vehicle.automobility.unattended.delay_he: Select the vacant-car timeout. The server may impose a shorter limit. Choosing a setting alone does not turn lights back on.
vehicle.automobility.unattended.work_hel: Only changes the timeout within the server limit. Does not turn lights on or change their engine link. For lighting with the engine off, disable that link in the Engine tab.
vehicle.automobility.unattended.rearm_he: Deliberately reselect the current mode. If lights are off, select low beam. This restores the unattended timer.
vehicle.automobility.unattended.restore_: Selected mode is kept. The engine link can switch lights off earlier. After restart, an unattended car waits for boarding or an explicit light request.
vehicle.automobility.renderer.title: Renderer details
vehicle.automobility.renderer.suppressed: Headlight projections are suppressed: Iris public shadow API is unavailable. See renderer details in general settings.
vehicle.automobility.renderer.projection: Projection guard: available. Normal shader shadow passes are excluded.
vehicle.automobility.renderer.direct: Optional optimization: %s · Batches observed since startup: %s
vehicle.automobility.renderer.vulkan_unv: Vulkan detected. This backend still needs its own qualification.
vehicle.automobility.renderer.scope: Backend and shader information is diagnostic; it does not certify every shaderpack.
vehicle.automobility.custom.priority.non: This group reserves full projection for your main car only. The in-view option can add more fully lit cars.
vehicle.automobility.custom.visible.none: No additional view-dependent full projections. The priority group keeps its own full-light budget.
vehicle.automobility.custom.cones.none_h: No additional cars receive visual cones. Cars with full projection keep their lights.
vehicle.automobility.custom.spill.off_he: Marker, brake, reverse and indicator lamps remain visible, but cast no colored light onto nearby surfaces. Lowest spill cost.
vehicle.automobility.custom.spill.limite: Short colored spill from up to %s selected cars, reaching at most %s blocks from their lamps. Smaller surface-lighting budget than Balanced; independent of full headlight counts.
vehicle.automobility.custom.spill.balanc: Colored spill from up to %s selected cars, reaching at most %s blocks from their lamps. More illuminated surfaces than Limited; independent of full headlight counts.
vehicle.automobility.custom.spill.high_h: Colored spill from up to %s selected cars, reaching at most %s blocks from their lamps, with finer detail near lamps. Highest spill budget; independent of full headlight counts.
vehicle.automobility.custom.drift.off_he: Drift smoke is not rendered. Drifting, braking and tire grip stay the same.
vehicle.automobility.custom.drift.full_h: Normal full drift smoke. Highest particle amount for this effect; driving behavior stays the same.
vehicle.automobility.custom.exhaust.on_h: Render normal smoke from cars with an exhaust. Turning it off saves this rendering work. Boost flames remain visible in either mode.
vehicle.automobility.custom.reset_help: Load the %s preset into this draft. Apply it with Done, then Save on the parent screen.
vehicle.automobility.custom.cancel_help: Return without accepting changes made in this editor.
vehicle.automobility.custom.done_help: Accept this draft and return. Click Save on the parent screen to apply and store it.
ui.automobility.title: Automobility settings
ui.automobility.page_switch_help: Each page saves separately. Save changes before switching; otherwise they are discarded.
ui.automobility.local: Changes apply after saving. Only on this computer.
ui.automobility.controls_help: Controls use your saved key bindings.
ui.automobility.remaps_preserved: Key bindings use the standard Minecraft editor.
ui.automobility.cruise_help: Requires a running engine and sufficient speed. The server controls the minimum activation speed.
ui.automobility.editor.title: HUD layout
ui.automobility.editor.anchor_help: The anchor preserves distance from the selected corner when the window changes size.
ui.automobility.editor.help: Drag • arrows move • Ctrl faster • Shift resizes map space
ui.automobility.editor.draft_help: Done in editor → Save on this page.
ui.automobility.hints_help: Automatic: first 8 seconds after mounting. Critical warnings remain independent of hints.
ui.automobility.legacy_help: Restore the original instruments and positions. Camera, effects and key bindings remain unchanged.
ui.automobility.editor.keyboard_help: Arrows move the selected part; Tab returns to buttons.
ui.automobility.common_hud_help: The common Automobility editor owns the new HUD layout.
ui.automobility.keys.title: Key conflicts
ui.automobility.keys.none: No shared bindings involving our keys.
ui.automobility.keys.no_remap: No automatic remapping. Edit bindings in standard Minecraft settings.
ui.automobility.editor.chrome_help: Hide toolbars to edit the screen edges. Use the same button to show them again.
ui.automobility.energy.help: Shows confirmed fuel or traction battery charge in the movable instrument cluster. Off or Previous layout keeps the original addon displays. Done in the editor changes this draft; Save applies it.
automobility.garage.inventory_recovery: Your garage item exchange is being recovered. Reconnect after the server completes recovery.
garage.automobility.engine_reason.busy: The vehicle or its energy is in use. Finish charging, refuelling or another operation.
garage.automobility.engine_reason.empty_: The tank must be empty when changing fuel family or converting between combustion and electric engines. Fuel is never converted into energy.
garage.automobility.engine_reason.invali: The selected engine changed or the exchange does not fit. Select the physical part again.
garage.automobility.engine_reason.unsupp: This engine has no qualified safe exchange support yet.
Fuel or battery data cannot be read safely. No exchange will be performed.
garage.automobility.engine_reason.duplic: The incoming and returned engine have the same battery identity. No exchange will be performed.
garage.automobility.engine_battery_unkno: Unreadable battery data — exchange requires validation.
garage.automobility.engine_exchange_rule: The battery follows its engine and is returned with it. Fuel stays with the car; a fuel-family conversion requires an empty tank.
